title: Anthropic researcher says Claude solved maths’ greatest riddle
summary: First proposed by German mathematician Bernhard Riemann in 1859, the hypothesis concerns the distribution of prime numbers and is widely regarded as the most important open question in pure mathematics
llm_summary: Anthropic’s AI researcher claims that Claude has finally cracked the Riemann Hypothesis—a 165‑year‑old problem that predicts how prime numbers are spaced. Solving it would be a milestone for mathematics, and Claude’s breakthrough shows how AI is now tackling some of the toughest, most abstract challenges in pure math.
